ground_truth.title: Compare Car Insurance Rates Online
ground_truth.main_content:
Compare auto insurance rates with confidence

Our car insurance rate comparison tool helps you compare your car insurance quote online with rates from other companies. At the end of your Progressive quote, simply look for the option to see car insurance rates from different insurers.

Follow these steps to compare rates:

1. Quote with Progressive
Get a quote that includes all the car insurance coverages you want. When you quote, make sure to list everyone who regularly drives your vehicle.

2. Compare rates from other companies
First, we'll show your Progressive quote. Then, look for the option to compare car insurance rates from other companies.

3. Choose the right policy for you
After reviewing your Progressive quote and rates from other trusted insurers, choose the option that works best for your needs.

What to compare beyond price

Comparing car insurance rates is helpful, but so is understanding what each insurer offers. Keep these factors in mind when you compare auto insurance companies:

Equal coverage
Car insurance rates are partially determined by your coverage amount. Quoting the same amount of coverage gives you a more accurate rate comparison.
Know how much coverage you need by using our car insurance coverage calculator. If you're focused on affordability, you can also explore cheap car insurance options.

Easy maintenance
Managing your auto policy should be easy, whether you want to adjust your coverage, add a driver, or ask a question.
Look for insurers that prioritize technology. Progressive's mobile app lets you manage your policy from your phone, and Snapshot encourages and rewards safe driving.

Financial ratings
Strong third-party financial ratings show how prepared a company is to meet its financial obligations, like paying out customer insurance claims.
Check an insurer's ratings with A.M. Best, Standard & Poor's, and Moody's. Progressive is rated A+ Superior with A.M. Best, reflecting our ability to honor our commitments to customers.

Claims handling
When an accident happens, the ability to quickly report and track your claim can get you back to normal faster.
Look for 24/7 claims support. With Progressive's auto claims team, you can report a claim anytime, track progress, and even upload photos using our mobile app.

Why compare with Progressive?

Trusted by millions
Progressive is one of the largest auto insurers.

Experts since 1937
We've been protecting drivers for decades.

See how we stack up
We make it easy to compare rates from other insurers.

Commonly asked questions

What information will I need to compare car insurance quotes?
When you compare car insurance rates, it's helpful to know your vehicle identification number (VIN), as well as your ticket and accident history to get a quote.

Why should I compare rates with Progressive?
When you compare rates with Progressive, you're starting from a quote with one of the nation's largest insurers. And once you get your Progressive quote, you'll have the option see rates from other trusted insurers so you can compare your options side by side.

Do I need to get a quote first to compare rates?
Yes, to compare rates with Progressive, you'll get a quote with us first. Once you see your quote, look for the option to start comparing rates from other insurers.

What should I consider when comparing auto insurance rates?
Although insurance companies look at similar factors to determine rates, each company has its own quoting methodology. This can result in differences in rates among insurers. For that reason, it's helpful to compare car insurance rates from different companies to find the best price.

Will I see the same rates if I quote directly on another insurer's website?
You might see a different rate if you quote directly with another insurer. For our customers' security, Progressive doesn't share sensitive data with other providers — rather than using your Social Security number, some of our comparison rates may use an assumed credit rating. And when you quote directly with other insurers, they may use information from different sources. If you have any questions about comparing rates, call 1-855-385-8049 so we can help.

Does the best auto insurance rate guarantee the best coverage?
Not necessarily. A lower rate could just mean less coverage for you and your vehicle. So when comparing rates, it's important to make sure that your coverages, limits, and deductibles match up from one company to the next. You should also make sure you're considering reputable insurance companies. While you're shopping around for the best car insurance, check out Progressive's customer reviews.

How can you get the best car insurance rate?
Each insurer rates customers differently, but getting the best car insurance rate for you typically involves comparing rates and qualifying for auto insurance discounts. Progressive car insurance customers qualify for an average of seven discounts. Learn more about lesser-known ways to lower your car insurance rate.

Does comparing rates affect my credit score?
No, quoting car insurance and comparing rates won't affect your credit score. Any credit check we perform to provide you with a quote won't be visible to other companies checking your credit.

How to shop for car insurance

Shopping for auto insurance can help you save. The best way to start is by comparing quotes from different companies.

To quote, you'll need:
- Your car's make, model, and year
- Your car's mileage
- Your driving history

To quote auto insurance, you typically need your car's make, model, model year, and mileage. You'll also be asked about your driving history, including any accidents.

If you already know the coverages and deductible you want, then make sure each quote includes them so you can make a true cost comparison.

If not, you can vary each quote to see how your car insurance premium changes when you add additional coverages.

You can also use our AutoQuote Explorer tool to compare your quoted rate against rates from different companies.

To buy your policy, you'll typically need:
- Driver's license number
- Social Security number
- Vehicle identification number (VIN)

Once you've found the right policy at the right price, you'll typically need one or more of the following to buy your new policy: your driver's license number, Social Security number, and vehicle identification number.
